description: Skoll REVIEW MEDIUM-12 finding (PKIX-szmo.7 triage). In pkix-lint/src/oscal/profile.rs around line 334, resolve_profile uses available_ids.retain(|id| wanted.contains(id)) which silently drops any control ID present in the Profile's include-controls but absent from the source Catalog. A typo in a Profile JSON control ID is silently ignored rather than surfaced as an error. Fix: after retain, check if wanted has entries not in the retained set and return a new ParseError variant (e.g., UnknownControlId) for the first unrecognized ID.
title: pkix-lint: OSCAL profile resolver silently drops unknown control IDs
